study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Chan et al., Developmental Cognitive Neuroscience, 2025
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Social behavior in ASD males: The interplay between cognitive flexibility, working memory, and functional connectivity deviations

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study used data from ABIDE I and ABIDE II collections. Males aged 5.1-14.0 years were included (n=816 total). The dataset was split into training (80% of non-ASD males, n=321) and testing (20% of non-ASD males n=77, plus ASD males n=418).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Data for the current study were from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) I and ABIDE II collections of the ABIDE initiative ... only males between ages 5.1 -14.0 years were included in this study (n = 816, Supplementary Fig 1).

answer.ABIDE (I+II): normative model training (80% of non-ASD males, n=321), testing (20% of non-ASD males n=77), and clinical application (ASD males n=418)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The training dataset was composed of 80% of non-ASD males (n=321) to model normative trajectories of between-network FC. The testing dataset was composed of the remaining 20% of non-ASD males (n=77) and ASD males (n=418). Deviation scores (z-scores) were calculated for the testing dataset to quantify rsFC atypicality from normative population. Further behavioral analyses were performed only in ASD patients.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: The study dataset was then split into training and testing datasets. The training dataset was composed of 80 % of non-ASD males, while the testing dataset was composed of the remaining 20 % of non-ASD males and ASD males... 80 % of non-ASD males were assigned to the training dataset (n = 321) to model normative trajectories of between-network FC. Normative models were then applied to the testing dataset (n = 77 non-ASD males; n = 418 ASD males) to derive deviation scores (z).

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: One normative model was constructed using Generalized Additive Models (GAMs) for between-network resting-state functional connectivity. Training used 321 non-ASD males. Testing included 77 non-ASD males (for validation) and 418 ASD males (for clinical application). Overall healthy control pool = 321 + 77 = 398.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: The training dataset was composed of 80 % of non-ASD males... Training N = 321... Testing (Control) N = 77

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Training dataset (n=321): Mean age 10.6 years (SD=1.8), range 5.9-13.9 years. Testing control dataset (n=77): Mean age 10.8 years (SD=1.6), range 6.5-13.8 years. Overall-phase weighted mean calculated as: (321*10.6 + 77*10.8)/(321+77) = 10.63 years. Pooled SD calculated from training and testing control groups.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The study exclusively included males. Authors stated: 'We focused exclusively on males due to the increased prevalence of ASD in males providing us with a greater study sample size and the sex differences observed in neurodevelopmental trajectories that would make it inadvisable to study males and females as one cohort.' Training phase: 321 males (100%). Overall healthy controls: 398 males (100%).
dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: We focused exclusively on males due to the increased prevalence of ASD in males (Werling and Geschwind, 2013) providing us with a greater study sample size and the sex differences observed in neurodevelopmental trajectories (Bethlehem et al., 2022) that would make it inadvisable to study males and females as one cohort.
